title: brown butter chocolate chip cookies
steps: Brown the butter until it smells like toffee, then let it cool for 15 minutes.
Whisk in both sugars, then the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, soda and salt, then the chocolate.
Rest the dough 30 minutes. Scoop and bake at 350°F for 11 minutes.
Flaky salt on top while warm.
review: the toffee-y butter is everything. rest the dough — worth the wait.

title: gochujang butter noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, saving a splash of the water.
Melt butter with garlic, stir in gochujang, soy and honey.
Toss the noodles in the sauce with a little noodle water until glossy.
Scallions and sesame on top.
review: weeknight hero. next time add a jammy egg.

title: lemon ricotta pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water.
Stir ricotta, lemon zest, juice, parmesan and lots of pepper together.
Toss with the hot pasta and enough pasta water to make it silky.
Tear basil over the top.

title: shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and spices for a minute, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs. Cover until the whites set.
Crumble feta, scatter parsley, serve with bread.

title: miso glazed salmon
steps: Whisk miso, mirin, maple and vinegar.
Brush over the salmon and let it sit 15 minutes.
Broil 7–9 minutes until the glaze catches.
Serve with rice and smashed cucumber.
review: glaze burns fast — watch it the last two minutes.

title: apple galette
steps: Toss the apples with sugar, cinnamon and lemon.
Roll the crust into a rough circle and pile the apples in the middle.
Fold the edges over, brush with egg, sprinkle with turbinado.
Bake at 400°F for 40–45 minutes until deep golden.
